svg.aria-label: Interactify CI/CD for AWS EC2: a pull request or push runs build.yaml. A push to main runs deploy.yaml, whose test job builds and tests the server; only if it passes does the build-and-push job build the Docker image, push it to Docker Hub and SSH into EC2, where the old container is stopped and the new image is pulled and run.
svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: on: PR → main, push → main · server/ client/ .github/workflows/
